content.title: The ebay site will not work properly for me
content.text: Hi all,I have been having problems navigating virtually all areas of ebay for a couple of months. There is nothing wrong with my computer, I have scanned it for malware, spyware, viruses etc, I have defragged, I have downloaded a new browser, but no matter, still too many problems to believe.When I connect to the internet, and open the browser (I have ebay.ca as my homepage) it either takes a really long time to load or the error message "this page cannot be displayed" comes up. If I go to any other website instead of ebay the page opens immediately. I have not been having any problems on any other website. If the ebay page won't load and you click on the "fix connection issues" link on the browser it always shows that there are no connection problems. I was using IE 10 and have recently downloaded Google Chrome.However, the real issues start once I am finally able to get into the site. Links won't load, the page will sit there with the loading symbol turning perpetually, until finally the "page cannot be displayed" error shows up. Every now and then I can get in and get to a couple of pages but that's it.I have been trying to make a purchase on my other id, I tried for several days, at first I couldn't even get the item page to come up, but when it finally did and I clicked on the buy it now button it repeatedly wouldn't take me to the payment page. Finally one day I just let it keep loading while I went and did some other surfing on a separate page, twenty minutes later I came back and it was still loading and never did. It is almost impossible to get my ebay messages to open, I usually just read them through my personal e-mail account. Unfortunately though, I had e-mailed the seller that I was trying to make the purchase from to ask if they offered shipping other than the GSP. I was finally able to see the reply they sent me and was glad to see that they offered USPS regular services. So I was able, after several attempts today using Google Chrome to get the buy it now button to work on the item, but when I tried to send them a message to request an invoice it wouldn't go through, and I got the usual error message. I hope I am going to be able to communicate with the seller to make the purchase.After weeks of trying to figure out what was going on here, and running every scan known to mankind on my computer, I finally just closed down all of my sales listings, that was back in September. I kept thinking it must just be ebay tinkering with things and making everything glitch, but that couldn't last this long could it? I can't figure out what else to try, besides just taking my business elsewhere. Any suggestions would be appreciated, please and thank-you. Kalvin, if you have a quick fix for me or info I am unaware of, I would really be grateful!Thanks, Heather
